question: What primary part of the female reproductive tract is affected by cervicitis?
explanation: Cervicitis specifically refers to inflammation localized to the cervix of the uterus. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h1)

question: How is chronic cervicitis best told apart from acute cervicitis?

options.B: Sudden and severe purulent vaginal discharge
options.D: Immediate response to single-dose antibiotic therapy

explanation: Chronic cervicitis features persistent infiltration of lymphocytes and plasma cells rather than sudden purulent discharge. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h1)

question: Neisseria gonorrhoeae is classified under which microbiological category?
explanation: Neisseria gonorrhoeae is a gram-negative diplococcus bacterium known for causing purulent infections. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h2)

question: A patient with cervicitis reports regular use of chemical contraceptive sponges and spermicides without any STIs. What kind of cause does this point to?
explanation: Exposure to spermicides and barrier devices can trigger localized inflammatory reactions without a microbial pathogen. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h2)

question: What main tissue change causes bleeding after sex in someone with cervicitis?
explanation: Inflammation makes the cervical blood vessels congested and fragile, leading to bleeding upon mechanical contact during intercourse. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h3)

question: Why do many women with Chlamydia-induced cervicitis remain undiagnosed for a long time?

options.A: The pathogen only affects the outer squamous epithelium
options.B: Routine diagnostic tests cannot detect intracellular bacteria
options.C: The infection frequently presents with minimal or absent symptoms
options.D: Symptoms only appear after menopause occurs

explanation: Chlamydial cervicitis is notoriously subtle, causing few noticeable symptoms and delaying healthcare-seeking behavior. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h3)

question: What is recognized as the gold standard laboratory test for detecting Chlamydia trachomatis?
explanation: Nucleic Acid Amplification Tests provide high sensitivity and specificity for identifying bacterial genetic material. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h4)

question: During a speculum examination for suspected cervicitis, what physical sign should the nurse expect to see?

options.A: A closed, pale, and completely dry external os
options.D: Extensive ulceration of the labia majora

explanation: Inflammation of the endocervical canal produces visible pus-like discharge and tissue that bleeds upon minor contact. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h4)

question: Confirmed gonococcal cervicitis is typically treated with which main antibiotic?
explanation: Ceftriaxone is the cornerstone antibiotic recommended for treating Neisseria gonorrhoeae infections. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h5)

question: Why is treating sexual partners at the same time essential in infectious cervicitis?

options.A: To enhance the systemic absorption of oral antibiotics
options.B: To prevent reinfection of the patient through untreated partners
options.C: To reduce the financial cost of community screening programs
options.D: To eliminate the requirement for follow-up pelvic examinations

explanation: Treating partners stops the cycle of transmission, ensuring the patient is not immediately reinfected after finishing medication. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h5)

question: What serious upper reproductive tract complication can happen if lower cervicitis is left untreated?
explanation: Pathogens can ascend past the cervix into the uterus and fallopian tubes, causing pelvic inflammatory disease. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h6)

question: A patient treated for chlamydial cervicitis asks when she can safely have sex again. What should the nurse advise?

options.A: Use hormonal contraceptives instead of barrier methods during healing
options.B: Resume intercourse immediately once the single-dose pill is swallowed
options.C: Abstain from intercourse until she and her partner finish treatment and symptoms resolve
options.D: Wait exactly twenty-four hours after starting vaginal suppositories

explanation: Complete abstinence is required until both partners finish therapy and all infectious signs clear to ensure successful eradication. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T14#GNS216_U5_T14_h6)
